`sarif-schema-2.1.0.json` is the unmodified OASIS SARIF 2.1.0 schema,
retrieved from the [OASIS specification repository](https://github.com/oasis-tcs/sarif-spec/blob/main/sarif-2.1/schema/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json).
It is vendored only for offline output-validation tests. The schema is governed
by the notices in the [OASIS SARIF specification](https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/os/sarif-v2.1.0-os.html).
